text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Trade between Macedonia and Poland which stood at $70 million in 1989 fell to only $12 million in 1996. It is expected to rise again to $100 million said a Polish government delegation during meetings in the Macedonian Chamber of commerce.

- French defence minister Charles Millon and his Macedonian counterpart Blagoja Handziski signed on Sunday in Ohrid an agreement on military cooperation between the two countries. Millon was received by Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov and Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski.
- Macedonians seek medical aid abroad. The Socail Security fund spent $3.8 million this year for out of country medical services.
- Construction company Mavrovo continues strike until the management resolvees problem with late salaries.
